reasons: Unexpected service failures are not handled in this file.

terms.meaning: Satellite-style or map-style pictures and summaries that give background about a place.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and runtime setting
sections.what: Loads the response helper and the earth observation service, and sets the Node.js runtime.
sections.why: Likely reason: server modules need the Node.js runtime.

sections.name: GET
sections.title: Imagery summary handler
sections.what: Returns the imagery summary for a case, or a not-found response when the service has none.
sections.why: Gives the panel one endpoint to read from.
sections.watch_out: There is no catch around the service call, so a service failure reaches the framework unhandled.

summary: Web address that returns the contextual imagery summary for one case.
purpose: Supplies data for the earth observation panel.
why: Likely reason: the panel loads its data from one place.
how: Reads the case id, asks the earth observation service for the insight, and returns it. If nothing is found, it returns a 404 with a message.
outputs: JSON with a data field, or a 404 with code CASE_NOT_FOUND.
risks: Unexpected errors from the service are not caught here.
debug: A 404 means the service found no synthetic case with that id.
